_doc: Story S3 question packs. BACKEND-ONLY report-generation input — NEVER synced to synchintro-app
and NEVER shipped to the browser. This file is intentionally OUTSIDE scripts/sync-taxonomy.cjs:
only the taxonomy sub-industry `id`s are the shared contract, so packs carry no hash manifest.
Keyed by taxonomy id. Resolution is sub-industry -> industry -> none via resolveQuestionPack(),
the same sub->industry->default shape as resolveReviewCeilings() in verticalConfigs.js.
Coverage: the four active-GTM verticals (Gate 1 risk note) — Retail/General Merchandise,
Junk Removal & Hauling, Dental Practice, Automotive. Every other sub-industry resolves to null
painThresholds tune the deterministic Competitive Weaknesses + Cost-of-Pain gates per vertical.
They ship seeded at the platform defaults (see DEFAULT_PAIN_THRESHOLDS in competitiveWeaknesses.js)
and are flagged ESTIMATES for validation on the first live pull — the moving_storage convention.
Do NOT ground-truth by generating reports during implementation.
demandDrivers and segments are the curated packs authored in PR-E; they are absent here on purpose
so PR-C's Evidence Ledger never claims a curated section that does not yet render.
